changelog.name: 1.3.1-A17_Ready-HyperOS4
changelog.body:
1.3.1 Released
Add CneApp Workaround to solve CneApp crashed caused by `android.permission.CONNECTIVITY_USE_RESTRICTED_NETWORKS` missing, this may the Android upstream change.

Make sure enable CneApp on your scope.

1.3.1 发布
新增CneApp Workaround，解决因为缺少`android.permission.CONNECTIVITY_USE_RESTRICTED_NETWORKS`导致Cne崩溃，最终导致电话挂掉的问题，这可能是Android上游的改动导致的

确保CneApp在作用域里启用

readme:
CustomOSHelper

An LSPosed enhancement module for ported devices

Features | Prerequisites | Installation

--- ## 📖 About **CustomOSHelper** is an [LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed)-based Xposed module that bridges two families of HALs into stock vendor systems on ported devices: - **LineageOS standard HALs** — LiveDisplay, Touch, PowerHal — independently defined and maintained by LineageOS - **[ChenSysHelper](https://github.com/Art-Chen/ChenSysHelper)** — a custom AIDL service providing additional HALs not covered by LineageOS (Sensor, Motor, Perf, FOD, etc.) This module provides the Java/Kotlin glue layer for both, fixing features that break when HALs are missing. Currently targeting **HyperOS 3.0 (Android 16)**; support for more systems planned. ### 🔌 Adapted HALs **LineageOS standard HALs** (independent of ChenSysHelper) | HAL | Interfaces | Description | | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | | **LiveDisplay** | `IDisplayModes`, `IColorBalance`, `IPictureAdjustment`, etc. (10) | Color profiles, reading mode, anti-flicker, sunlight enhancement | | **Touch** | `ITouchscreenGesture`, `IGloveMode`, `IHighTouchPollingRate`, etc. (6) | Screen-off gestures, glove mode, key disabler/swapper | | **PowerHal** | `IPower`, `IPowerHintSession` | Power hint sessions | **ChenSysHelper** (custom, no HAL equivalent in LineageOS) | HAL | Interfaces | Description | | ---------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------- | | **Sensor** | `ISensorHelper` | Pocket/pickup/motion detect remapping | | **Motor** | `IMotorHelper` | Pop-up camera motor control | | **Perf** | `IPerfHelper` | Performance tier configuration | | **FOD** | `IFodHelper` | Under-display fingerprint touch events | | **Common** | `ICommon` | General-purpose helper extensions | --- ## ✨ Features - **Screen-off gestures** — HAL-level touch gestures (single/double tap, swipe, letter shapes) with customizable actions - **IFAA fingerprint payment** — IFAA service hook for Alipay fingerprint auth on Oplus devices - **Voice trigger** — Force voice wake-up support via LegacyVoiceTriggerUtil hook - **Refresh rate** — Force custom refresh rate mode in PowerKeeper - **LiveDisplay** — Full LiveDisplay feature adaptation (10+ display enhancements) - **Device info card** — Hardware specs injection into Settings (SoC, battery, camera, display) - **Alert Slider** — Three-position slider support (OnePlus devices) - **Sensor remapping** — Pocket/pickup/motion detect sensor compatibility - **Camera motor key** — Pop-up camera protection with confirmation dialog - **FOD / UDFPS** — Enhanced under-display fingerprint touch handling - And more... --- ## 📋 Prerequisites | Requirement | Notes | | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | | Root | Magisk / KernelSU / APatch | | LSPosed | v1.9.2+ with Zygisk | | System | HyperOS 3.0/4.0 (Android 16/17); | --- ## 🚀 Installation 1. Enable the module in **LSPosed Manager** 2. Check recommended scopes: `system`, `com.android.systemui`, `com.android.settings`, etc. 3. Restart target apps (or use Hot Reload) 4. Configure features in the module settings --- ## 🙏 Credits - [LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed) - [KavaRef](https://github.com/KFCFans/KavaRef) - [LineageOS](https://lineageos.org/) — HAL interface definitions & IFAA reference --- ## 📄 License © 2025-2026 Art_Chen

自定义OSHelper 用于移植设备的 LSPod 增强模块

功能 | 先决条件 | 安装

--- ## 📖 关于 **CustomOSHelper** 是一个基于 [LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed) 的 Xposed 模块，它将两个 HAL 系列桥接到移植设备上的库存供应商系统中： - **LineageOS 标准 HAL** — LiveDisplay、Touch、PowerHal — 由 LineageOS 独立定义和维护 - **[ChenSysHelper](https://github.com/Art-Chen/ChenSysHelper)** — 自定义 AIDL 服务，提供 LineageOS 未涵盖的其他 HAL（传感器、电机、Perf、FOD 等） 该模块为两者提供了 Java/Kotlin 粘合层，修复了 HAL 丢失时中断的功能。 目前的目标是 **HyperOS 3.0 (Android 16)**；计划支持更多系统。 ### 🔌 改编的 HAL **LineageOS 标准 HAL**（独立于 ChenSysHelper） |哈尔 |接口|描述 | | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | | **实时显示** | `IDisplayModes`、`IColorBalance`、`IPictureAdjustment` 等 (10) |颜色配置文件、阅读模式、防闪烁、阳光增强 | | **触摸** | `ITouchscreenGesture`、`IGloveMode`、`IHighTouchPollingRate` 等 (6) |屏幕关闭手势、手套模式、按键禁用/交换 | | **PowerHal** | `IPower`、`IPowerHintSession` |电源提示会话 | **ChenSysHelper**（自定义，LineageOS 中没有等效的 HAL） |哈尔 |接口|描述 | | ---------- | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | | **传感器** | `ISensorHelper` |口袋/拾音器/运动检测重新映射 | | **电机** | `IMotorHelper` |弹出式摄像头电机控制| | **性能** | `IPerfHelper` |性能层配置| | **外物检测** | `IFodHelper` |屏下指纹触摸事件 | | **常见** | `ICommon` |通用帮助扩展 | --- ## ✨ 特点 - **屏幕关闭手势** — HAL 级触摸手势（单击/双击、滑动、字母形状），具有可自定义操作 - **IFAA 指纹支付** — 用于 Oplus 设备上支付宝指纹验证的 IFAA 服务挂钩 - **语音触发** — 通过 LegacyVoiceTriggerUtil 挂钩强制语音唤醒支持 - **刷新率** — 在 PowerKeeper 中强制自定义刷新率模式 - **LiveDisplay** — 完整的 LiveDisplay 功能适配（10 多项显示增强功能） - **设备信息卡** — 将硬件规格注入设置（SoC、电池、相机、显示器） - **警报滑块** - 三位置滑块支持（OnePlus 设备） - **传感器重新映射** — 袖珍/拾音器/运动检测传感器兼容性 - **相机电机键** — 带确认对话框的弹出式相机保护 - **FOD / UDFPS** — 增强的屏下指纹触摸处理 - 还有更多... --- ## 📋 先决条件 |要求|笔记| | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | |根| Magisk/KernelSU/APatch | | LS 构成 | v1.9.2+ 与 Zygisk | |系统| HyperOS 3.0/4.0（Android 16/17）； | --- ## 🚀 安装 1. 在**LSposed Manager**中启用该模块 2. 检查推荐范围：`system`、`com.android.systemui`、`com.android.settings` 等。 3. 重新启动目标应用程序（或使用热重载） 4. 在模块设置中配置功能 --- ## 🙏 积分 - [LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed) - [KavaRef](https://github.com/KFC粉丝/KavaRef） - [LineageOS](https://lineageos.org/) — HAL 接口定义和 IFAA 参考 --- ## 📄 许可证 © 2025-2026 艺术_陈
